# opnsense_haproxy_healthcheck (Resource)

HAProxy health monitors (**Services ▸ HAProxy ▸ Settings ▸ Rules & Checks ▸ Health Monitors**, plugin `os-haproxy`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_haproxy_healthcheck" "http" {
  name = "http"
  type = "http"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name to identify this Health Monitor.

### Optional

- `agent_port` (Number) Specify the TCP port used for agent checks. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `checkport` (Number) Provide an optional TCP communication port to use during health checks, i.e. 80 or 443. The server port will used for health checks when no port is specified. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `db_user` (String) dbUser. Defaults to ``.
- `description` (String) Description for this Health Monitor. Defaults to ``.
- `esmtp_domain` (String) Specify the domain name to present to the server for ESMTP health checks. Defaults to ``.
- `force_ssl` (Boolean) force_ssl. Defaults to `false`.
- `http_expression` (String) Select health check expression. One of `status`, `rstatus`, `string`, `rstring`. Defaults to ``.
- `http_expression_enabled` (Boolean) Enabled. Defaults to `false`.
- `http_host` (String) Specify HTTP host to use for health check. Requires HTTP/1.1. Defaults to `localhost`.
- `http_method` (String) Select HTTP method for health check. One of `options`, `head`, `get`, `put`, `post`, `delete`, `trace`. Defaults to `options`.
- `http_negate` (Boolean) Use this to invert the meaning of the expression. Defaults to `false`.
- `http_uri` (String) Specify HTTP request URI for health check. Defaults to `/`.
- `http_value` (String) Specify a value to match with the expression. Defaults to ``.
- `http_version` (String) Select HTTP version for a HTTP health check. One of `http10`, `http11`, `http2`. Defaults to `http10`.
- `interval` (String) Select interval (in milliseconds) between two consecutive health checks. This value can be overriden in backend pool and real server configuration. Defaults to `2s`.
- `mysql_post41` (Boolean) Send checks compatible with MySQL server 4.1 and later. Defaults to `false`.
- `mysql_user` (String) Specify the username to be used for database health checks. Defaults to ``.
- `pgsql_user` (String) Specify the username to be used for database health checks. Defaults to ``.
- `smtp_domain` (String) Specify the domain name to present to the server for SMTP health checks. Defaults to ``.
- `ssl` (String) This option forces encryption of all health checks over SSL, regardless of whether the server uses SSL or not for the normal traffic. One of `nopref`, `ssl`, `sslsni`, `nossl`. Defaults to `nopref`.
- `ssl_sni` (String) The host name sent in the SNI TLS extension to the server. Overrides the server's SNI setting for health checks. Defaults to ``.
- `tcp_enabled` (Boolean) Enabled. Defaults to `false`.
- `tcp_match_type` (String) Select how to look for a specific pattern in the response. One of `string`, `rstring`, `binary`. Defaults to `string`.
- `tcp_match_value` (String) Specify the pattern to look for in the response buffer. If the match is set to binary, then the pattern must be passed as a serie of hexadecimal digits in an even number. Defaults to ``.
- `tcp_negate` (Boolean) Use this to invert the meaning of the expression. Defaults to `false`.
- `tcp_send_value` (String) Specify a value to match with the expression. Defaults to ``.
- `type` (String) Select type of health check. One of `tcp`, `http`, `agent`, `ldap`, `mysql`, `pgsql`, `redis`, `smtp`, `esmtp`, `ssl`. Defaults to `http`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the health monitor.
